cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pulled a peg when you pulled one. Remember me saying we'd see the stars? This fallen tent is where the evening opens up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I removed a spare peg. Yours was holding up our only shelter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, opening the view. That remark about stars wasn't idle conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's cloudy. I have a tarp we can rig over the sleeping bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Rig it high. First the tent, now the clouds: I was building up to how much work we'd do for that view.

reason: Replace unsupported confidence framing with a specific copied misconception that directs the Drive, retaining seed causality only where it remains understandable in the actual dialogue.
